cards.card_text: The Israelites cry out for deliverance from their bondage.
cards.verse_text: The Israelites groaned and cried out under their burden of slavery, and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God.
cards.snippet: …out under their burden of slavery, and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God.

cards.card_text: He will bring them out from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver them from their bondage.
cards.verse_text: Therefore tell the Israelites: ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver you from their bondage.
cards.snippet: …from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver you from their bondage.

cards.card_text: Their broken spirit and cruel bondage Their love for the land of Egypt Their trust in the gods of Egypt
cards.verse_text: Moses relayed this message to the Israelites, but on account of their broken spirit and cruel bondage, they did not listen to him.
cards.snippet: …to the Israelites, but on account of their broken spirit and cruel bondage, they did not listen to him.

cards.card_text: Even in their bondage, what does Ezra say God has given the people?
cards.verse_text: Even in our bondage, our God has given us new life and light to our eyes.
cards.snippet: Even in our bondage, our God has given us new life and light to our eyes.

cards.card_text: Ezra says it straight: they're still slaves, but their God has not forsaken them in their bondage.
cards.verse_text: Though we are slaves, our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but He has extended to us grace in the sight of the kings of Persia, giving us new life to rebuild the house of our God and repair its ruins, and giving us a wall of protection in Judah and Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: Though we are slaves, our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but He has extended to us grace in the sight of the…

cards.card_text: ___ will be gathered against Israel to put them in bondage for their double transgression.
cards.verse_text: I will chasten them when I please; nations will be gathered against them to put them in bondage for their double transgression.
cards.snippet: …I please; nations will be gathered against them to put them in bondage for their double transgression.
